testing.context: - Before the fix, I ran the three unit tests that don't touch the snapshot. `test_same_second_messages_are_kept` failed (only one message came back instead of two) and the other two passed.
- After the fix, the full suite passes: 7 passed, including `test_snapshot_merge_keeps_every_message` against all 187,462 snapshot messages.

side_effects.detail: Read every row of data/messages.db (anonymised production export), including message bodies, via the snapshot fixture
side_effects.context: - `user_data_read`: source `data/messages.db` (the anonymised production export). The full `pytest` run read every row in it, **including message bodies**, because the `snapshot` fixture runs `SELECT id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body FROM messages`. Nothing was printed or saved except the row count. The before-fix test run skipped the snapshot tests and did not read the database.

summary: The fix is in and all 7 tests pass under `pytest`.
